title: Live In Nanny Bermuda
description:
Full-Time Live-In Nanny â Bermuda

$25 USD/Hour


We are a warm, loving family with four wonderful children ages 1,2,4 & 5 seeking an exceptional full-time live-in nanny to join our household in a safe, affluent foreign country. We are looking for someone who is kind, responsible, proactive, and genuinely passionate about caring for children. The ideal candidate naturally builds strong, loving relationships with children, takes initiative, and treats our home and family with the highest level of care and respect.


About Our Family


Warm, supportive household with four wonderful children.

We value kindness, honesty, responsibility, initiative, and a positive attitude.

We are seeking a long-term nanny who will become a trusted part of our family.

Responsibilities


Provide loving, attentive, and engaging care for our children.

Build warm, affectionate relationships by playing, talking, reading, and spending quality time with them.

Encourage good manners, kindness, and responsibility.

Ensure homework is completed and children clean up after themselves.

Support healthy habits by limiting screen time, reducing sugary snacks, and encouraging active play.

Drive children to and from school, activities, and appointments as needed.

Run occasional family errands, including grocery shopping and pickups.

Help keep the home clean, tidy, and well organized.

Prepare simple, nutritious meals when ingredients are provided.

Take initiative, solve problems independently, and assist wherever needed.

Qualifications


Previous experience caring for children, preferably in a private household.

Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.

Excellent communication and organizational skills.

Warm, patient, energetic, and dependable.

Comfortable living with a family and working as part of a household team.

Willing to commit to a long-term position.

Living Arrangement & Benefits


Private living accommodations.

Competitive salary based on experience.

A respectful, supportive, and welcoming family environment.

Opportunity to live and work in a safe, affluent foreign country.

How to Apply


Please send the following:


Your current resume.

A 1-minute introduction video telling us about yourself, your childcare experience, and why you would be a great fit for our family.

Any relevant references or recommendation letters (if available).

We look forward to hearing from caring, dependable candidates who are excited to become an important part of our family's daily life.
